item.title: 8 Turn-Based RPGs With Near-Perfect Skill Grids
item.description:
Leveling up in a turn-based RPG should feel exciting, but I can lose interest when a new level simply bumps up a few of my numbers. The best skill grids give me something to think about between battles. I want to study the paths ahead, pick out the upgrades I need, and see my decisions pay off when I get back into a fight. I want the menu to be fun.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover
8 Best Turn-Based Strategy Games That Require Deep Thinking, Ranked

Players need to make every turn and move count in these strategy games that will have them scratching their heads and weighing their options.

By Alex Daniel Reid

There are plenty of ways to get that feeling. Some games use sprawling boards that slowly open up, while others offer smaller trees that become interesting when you start combining abilities. I'm also including configurable systems like Orbments and Mastery Boards, since they require the same kind of planning. Regardless, each of these RPGs puts me in control of character development, and that's all you can ask for.

Class Trees Make Every Discovery Exciting

You can equip a subclass to borrow another job's commands, and learned passives remain useful even after I switch roles.

I enjoy how much freedom those overlapping systems provide. My fighter can pick up healing abilities, while a spellcaster benefits from a passive learned in a completely different class. The trees are small, but that works. Most of the fun comes from finding combinations that make my four-person team work in ways I hadn't considered before.

Hidden Panels Make Progression Feel Like Exploration

Dragon Quest 11 S: Echoes of an Elusive Age makes spending Skill Points feel like uncovering a map. Its Character Builder consists of connected hexagonal panels, with Secret Panels appearing after I unlock enough surrounding spaces. Each character has different paths to follow. Erik, for example, can develop around knives or boomerangs, and his abilities change noticeably depending on where I invest.

I like how easy the board is to understand without making every decision obvious. New sections open as the story progresses. Rectification also lets me refund whole skill categories for 20 gold per Skill Point. That makes experimenting painless, and hidden panels make it rewarding as well.

Fantasian Neo Dimension

Growth Maps Reward Experimentation

FANTASIAN Neo Dimension
Released
December 5, 2024

WHERE TO PLAY

DIGITAL
PHYSICAL

Developer(s)
Mistwalker
Genre(s)
RPG, JRPG
Powered by

The Growth Maps in Fantasian Neo Dimension are built for players who enjoy changing tactics. They arrive in the second half of the adventure, giving each character a connected board of active abilities and passive upgrades. Skill Points buy the nodes, and Release Mode lets me reset those choices for free.

7 JRPGs With Virtually Perfect Job Systems, Ranked

Some JRPGs take job systems to another level, giving players more than enough freedom to experiment with and customize different party member roles.

By Nikol Nikolova

That flexibility becomes especially useful against the game's demanding bosses. When a fight exposes a weakness in my setup, I can move points into stronger defenses or different abilities instead of grinding for more levels. My one frustration is having to play so much before the Growth Maps become available.

Final Fantasy 10

The Sphere Grid Makes Every Level Feel Tangible

Final Fantasy 10 gives leveling up a satisfying physical quality. Battles award Ability Points which generate Sphere Levels, letting characters move around an enormous connected board. You then use different spheres to activate stat boosts and abilities along the route. Tidus and Yuna start on role-specific paths, but those boundaries gradually loosen.

I love the feeling of inching toward an ability I've been eyeing for several battles. Key Spheres unlock routes into other characters' sections, so long-term development becomes surprisingly flexible. The HD Remaster's Standard and Expert versions give me different ways to approach the board, even if the Standard path starts fairly linear. Moving from node to node never stops feeling rewarding.

The Legend Of Heroes: Trails From Zero

Orbment Circuits Turn Spellcasting Into A Puzzle

The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero
JRPG
Systems

September 27, 2022

WHERE TO PLAY

DIGITAL
PHYSICAL

Developer(s)
Nihon Falcom
Genre(s)
JRPG
Powered by

The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero approaches character building through Enigma Orbments. You place Quartz in slots to gain stat bonuses and elemental values, and the totals along each connected line determine which magical Arts you can cast. Moving one Quartz to another slot can change available spells.

13 Best Tactical RPGs With Deep Character Customization, Ranked

Those who love to customize their characters to be just the way they like are in for something special in these tactical RPGs.

By Mark Sammut

I find that little puzzle especially enjoyable when I'm preparing for a difficult encounter. Unlocking more slots with Sepith expands my options, and longer lines make advanced Arts easier to assemble. I weigh each Quartz's stat boost against the spells it unlocks. It's an equipment-based system rather than a permanent skill tree, but the planning scratches the same itch.

Monster Sanctuary

Every Monster's Skill Tree Supports The Team

Monster Sanctuary
Action-Adventure
Systems

August 28, 2019

WHERE TO PLAY

SUBSCRIPTION
DIGITAL
PHYSICAL

ESRB
t
Publisher(s)
Team17
Genre(s)
Action-Adventure
Powered by

Every creature in Monster Sanctuary has its own skill tree, and you have to consider how those choices affect the rest of your party. Leveling grants points for attacks and support abilities, while higher levels unlock more options. At level 40, a monster gains access to three Ultimate skills and can equip one.

The real fun is putting three monsters together and watching their abilities click. A creature that spreads poison becomes much more dangerous beside an ally that buffs damage over time. Shielding specialists can also keep fragile attackers alive long enough to do their work. I enjoy revisiting old monsters with a new team in mind, even when the planning gets complicated.

Triangle Strategy

Weapon Upgrades Make Every Investment Count

Triangle Strategy
RPG
Tactical
Systems
Released
March 4, 2022

WHERE TO PLAY

DIGITAL
PHYSICAL

ESRB
T For Teen // Blood, Fantasy Violence, Language, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol
Developer(s)
Square Enix, Artdink
Genre(s)
RPG, Tactical
Powered by

Triangle Strategy keeps its characters in clearly defined roles, and its weapon-upgrade boards respect those identities. At the Encampment blacksmith, you'll spend money and materials on improvements tailored to each unit. Hughette, for instance, can strengthen the effects of her blinding or sleep abilities. More upgrades appear as weapons improve.

10 Greatest Party-Based RPGs Of All Time, Ranked

Put together a group of highly capable people and venture out. Here's which party-based RPGs dominate their niche.

1
By Tristan Jurkovich

I appreciate how the limited resources make even small upgrades feel important. Spending valuable materials on one character means holding off on another, so I have to pay attention to who has been carrying recent battles. These boards don't let me completely reinvent a unit, and that's part of their appeal. Everyone retains a distinct purpose on the battlefield.

Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children

Mastery Boards Are Built For Tinkering

Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children
RPG
Tactical
Systems
Released
April 23, 2020

WHERE TO PLAY

DIGITAL

Developer(s)
Dandylion
Genre(s)
RPG, Tactical
Platform(s)
PC
Powered by

Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children gives players an almost ridiculous number of ways to customize a character. Its Mastery Boards hold equippable passives, with limited slots and Training Points keeping builds under control. Certain combinations activate Mastery Set bonuses, which make choosing the right group of abilities more interesting than simply equipping whatever looks the strongest on its own.

You can build a character around counterattacks, then rearrange the board to try a completely different approach. New Masteries will make you reconsider earlier choices. I enjoy that kind of tinkering, especially when a combination changes how someone behaves in battle. The complicated interface makes comparisons harder than they need to be, but experimenting with the possibilities keeps pulling me back.

item.title: How to Change Servers in ROB RUN
item.description:
ROB RUN lets players explore different states, build hideouts, earn money, and interact with other players in a shared world. Still, your experience can differ quite a bit depending on which server you join. Some states may already have established settlements, while others offer more room to build and start from scratch.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

You might also want to move because your friends are playing somewhere else or because your current location has become too difficult to survive in. Whatever your reason, changing servers isn’t something you do without any preparation. Moving to another state can affect your property, stored items, and overall progress, so it is important to understand what happens before making the switch in ROB RUN .

How to Become a Cop in Rob Run

Here’s how you can become a cop in ROB RUN and make money.

By Usama Ali

How to Move to Another State in ROB RUN

Unlike many multiplayer games, ROB RUN does not have a straightforward server selection option in its main settings menu. Instead, you need to go through the federal prison system to change your current state/region/server.

Firstly, surrender to the feds. Go to your Settings menu and head to the Other tab. Here, you should find the Surrender to Feds option. Select it and confirm your decision to get transported to prison.

You can also use the global map to find the Prison location in the northwestern part of the map and choose the surrender option from there.

Once you arrive at the federal prison, speak to the Tattoo Artist and look for an opportunity to escape. You will get the chance to select a different state when you make your way out. Choose the server you want to join and confirm your selection to complete the transfer.

If you are switching servers to play with friends, ask them for their exact state or server details before starting the process. This will save you from having to surrender and switch again.

What Happens to Your Items When You Switch Servers?

Before changing your server in ROB RUN , remember that moving to another state is not a simple location change. It basically gives you a new start, and the game will confiscate your belongings from your previous state.

This includes your existing property, base, hideout, and other items you have collected or stored there. You should not expect these belongings to follow you to your new server.

There is also a prison sentence involved. Surrendering won't erase the crimes you've already committed and the amount of property confiscated can influence how long you spend in jail.

Mailbox items are tied to your current server and will become inaccessible once the transfer is complete. Make sure you grab all your rewards first.

In general, it’s a good idea to use any valuable resources you have before surrendering, rather than abandoning them.

Which Progress and Rewards Can You Keep?

Although switching servers comes with some losses, not everything disappears when you move.

Your jail time and criminal progress metrics remain relevant. In fact, serving longer sentences can build your reputation in the criminal world and unlock additional rewards, including tattoos.

B-Coin is another important exception. Since this currency is purchased with credits and functions separately from your regular belongings, it is generally protected from property confiscation.

ROB RUN also opens new servers as existing ones fill up, so you might find fresh states becoming available over time.

Can You Change Servers Without Losing Your Property?

There is one exception to the usual server transfer rules. Those who live in the Highlands can switch to another state while keeping their properties. The Highlands is home to some of the strongest and most established players in ROB RUN . You may be able to retain your property, but competing with experienced players can make the area challenging.

We recommend considering your current progress and the strength of your character before choosing this route. Keeping your belongings is useful, but it does not automatically make the new state easier to survive in.

How to Join Your Friend's Server in ROB RUN

If you want to play ROB RUN with a friend, both of you need to be on the same server. Although you’ll encounter players from different states in certain locations, party features generally require everyone to share the same server.

If you try inviting someone from another state, you’ll possibly receive an error.

To fix this, first ask your friend which region they are currently playing in. Then, decide who will switch servers. The player moving to the other state must surrender to the feds and select the friend's server after escaping from prison.

Once both of you are in the same state, you can send a party invitation through the player menu.

In Looty Bay, all party members must also choose the same role, whether Criminal, Police, or Civilian. You cannot invite someone who is currently involved in a clan conflict, either.

FAQs

Do I lose my money when changing servers?

Your regular belongings and property are confiscated when you move. However, B-Coin is generally protected from these seizures and stays with your character.

Can I play with friends on different servers?

While you can encounter players from different servers in Looty Bay, party features require everyone to be in the same state. One player must switch servers before you can play together as a party.

Can I change my server directly from Settings in ROB RUN?

No, there is no regular server selection menu in the main settings. You need to surrender to the feds, go to prison, and select another state when escaping.

Related Guides

There is so much more to explore in ROB RUN . We have more guides to help you get comfortable with the game's different features. Learn how to earn cash quickly in How to Make Money Fast in ROB RUN , find out how the money laundering system works in How to Launder Money in ROB RUN , or get started with the police role using our How to Become a Cop in ROB RUN guide.

item.title: Best Phantom Blade Zero Mods
item.description:
​The PC version of Phantom Blade Zero enjoys a thriving modding community that has created mods introducing new quality-of-life features, gameplay mechanics, and unique elements to PBZ which any player on PC can download and enjoy.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

Here are our top picks for players looking to improve the Phantom Blade experience and tailor it to their preference.

Phantom Blade Zero - Best Weapons Tier List

From elemental blades to razor-sharp fans, these are the strongest weapons to wield in Phantom Blade Zero.

1
By Vlad Mazanko

Best Quality of Life Mods for Phantom Blade Zero

Movement Speed - PBZMoveSpeed

  • Link

Lets you manually adjust your character’s walking, jogging, and sprinting speed (0.5x to 3x). Adjustments are applied instantly and can be modified in-game if you have the Mods Menu mod installed as well (more details below).

Instant Rest - Skip Rest Animation

  • Link

Removes the bell-ringing animation that occurs every time you interact with a bell in the game. Instead, it immediately transitions to the menu that lets you fast travel and upgrade equipment.

Mods Menu - In-Game Mod Settings

  • Link

Allows players to adjust the settings of various mods in-game, without having to go through .ini files and have those changes applied to the game instantly. Only works for the mods that support it.

item.title: Resident Evil Requiem Just Won Its First GOTY Award, but Its Real Test Is Still Coming
item.description:
It's been a minute since Resident Evil Requiem has been back in the spotlight, but Capcom's latest entry in its beloved horror series has taken home a coveted award: The Golden Joystick's Ultimate Game of the Year. Resident Evil Requiem was one of the first big hits of the year, so it's not too surprising that the game received such a big award. However, the most surprising part about the event was just how close the race was, and that race is only going to get tighter as the year continues.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

Resident Evil Requiem was one of several Golden Joystick Awards nominees that was worthy of being chosen, but Leon and Grace's terrifying journey was almost beaten by two other games. This year has seen the debut of a lot of great titles, so a tight race keeps things exciting. There's nothing wrong with some good, solid competition, but Resident Evil Requiem 's chances at winning more awards as the year continues are going to be put to the test once GTA 6 debuts.

Every Resident Evil Game, Ranked From Shortest To Longest

Want to know which is the longest Resident Evil game? Well, let's go through all the games in the series, from RE to Requiem.

By Bronwyn Lee

Resident Evil Requiem Now Has One of the Year's Biggest Awards, But GTA 6 Is Coming in Hot

Resident Evil Requiem narrowly beat Phantom Blade Zero and Crimson Desert . The super-tight race saw Requiem gain 17% of the vote, while Phantom Blade Zero amassed 16% and Crimson Desert got 15% of the vote. Those numbers are just a small taste of just how competitive this year has been. Games like Crimson Desert brought a vast open-world adventure to gamers, and Phantom Blade Zero has proven to be a beautiful action-packed RPG.

As interesting as those two games are, Resident Evil Requiem was the more well-rounded of the bunch, and being one of the most popular horror franchises in the industry definitely helped, too. Requiem is one of the best Resident Evil games that Capcom has released in a while. Between the intense action and hardcore scares, the game was a wonderful balance of everything the franchise has become so well-known for in its 30 years. Having such a major award under its belt now puts Resident Evil Requiem in an incredibly strong position for the other upcoming awards ceremonies, but it's hard to imagine a world where it beats GTA 6 at future events.

GTA 6 Is Expected to Sweep This Year's Game Awards

  • GTA 6 did not qualify for the Golden Joystick Awards.
  • GTA 6 recently qualified for The Game Awards.
  • The Game Awards air on December 10.

There were a lot of questions earlier this year about whether GTA 6 would qualify for the 2026 Game Awards or not, and gamers recently got an answer. The GTA 6 release date falls on November 19, while The Game Awards cutoff is November 20. This cutoff time definitely feels like it was by design, but there is still a possibility that it could simply be a coincidence. Regardless, Rockstar's long-awaited game feels destined to be among the event's Game of the Year nominees.

If GTA 6 secures a Game of the Year nomination, then Resident Evil Requiem 's time in the victory spotlight is more than likely going to be short-lived. GTA 6 pre-orders alone are breaking records, so there's no telling the wave it will create once the game is finally here. Even gamers who aren't interested in GTA 6 understand the cultural impact that this release will have on the world, and that's hard to overlook when considering which games deserve to win a title as big as Game of the Year. Even if Resident Evil Requiem doesn't win any other major awards, the fact that it managed to secure this kind of accolade in the same year that GTA 6 launched is worth celebrating.

2026's Game of the Year Showdown Will Be Between GTA 6 and Ocarina of Time

It's been a good year for games. 007 First Light , Pragmata , Control Resonant , Forza Horizon 6 , The Blood of Dawnwalker , and Mina the Hollower are just a few of the other games that have made 2026 a strong year for gaming. Resident Evil Requiem kicked the year off in a thrilling way, but the hard truth is that the game secured the Golden Joystick because both GTA 6 and the Ocarina of Time remake missed the cutoff.

After 21 Years, Resident Evil 4 Finally Has Co-Op

GTA 6 taking home the Game of the Year award at The Game Awards feels like a given, but the Ocarina of Time reviews might hint at a far more competitive head-to-head battle than many have expected. After all, Red Dead Redemption 2 was beaten by God of War at the 2018 Game Awards. Both clearly deserved the nomination, but it also serves as a reminder that a Rockstar game isn't a guaranteed winner. Ocarina of Time is now the highest-rated game of the year so far, and that makes the next few months even more competitive than the year already has been.

item.title: Fable Reveals Four Full Minutes of Gameplay
item.description:
With the release of Fable just a few months away, Xbox and Playground Games shared a new look at one of the areas that players will visit once the upcoming action RPG hits store shelves in February. As the fourth entry in the Fable franchise, the 2027 reboot will take players to a reimagined Albion that aims to set itself apart from its predecessors.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

The new trailer came weeks after Playground Games underwent a major shift. As part of Xbox’s ongoing restructuring efforts, Playground Games and Turn 10 Studio were combined into a single studio. Previously, Turn 10 worked on the Forza Motorsport series, with Playground Games also handling work on both Forza Horizon and Fable . With the two studios now merged into one entity, it remains to be seen how the ongoing development of Fable and both Forza franchises will be handled in the future.

Xbox Game Pass Officially Gets Its 11th New Game Just 12 Days Into November

Nearly halfway into November 2026, Xbox Game Pass is still averaging just under one new title per day, having just added its 11th such game.

By Dominik Bošnjak

Fable Shares New Look at Action Combat

Five months after Playground Games shared an extensive 30-minute deep dive into Fable , the English studio offered another look at the game's combat system. Lasting approximately four minutes, the new Fable gameplay video was captured via an internal development build. The trailer starts with some dialogue between the Hero player character and an NPC called Arden. The pair come across a forest that has been corrupted, with dark vines and thorns sprouting from the ground. After walking a short way, the Hero and Arden are ambushed by a group of skeletons and wood nymphs. The Hero then casts a spell that causes some of the monsters to float in the air and finishes them off with a mix of weapon skills and some cooldown-based abilities.

Arden and the Hero then discover the source of the forest's dark corruption, as red-colored magic seeps from the ground beneath a shrine. The Fable gameplay preview ends as a voice belonging to the Hero of Bower calls out to the player character, asking them to come closer. Playground Games stated throughout the video that the footage was recorded in 4K via the PC version with ultra graphics preset enabled. Given that the PC system requirements for playing Fable using the ultra preset will require high-end components, such as the AMD Ryzen 9 7900X processor and the Nvidia GeForce RTX 5080 graphics card, players will need to pay some serious money beforehand to achieve the same results.

Fable 's February 23 launch date will come amid a busy time for gamers, with several games launching throughout the month. Fable will share its release date with Final Fantasy 14: Evercold and will arrive just days after Persona 4 Revival and God of War Laufey hit store shelves. Although Microsoft has pivoted toward making some of its IPs exclusive to PC and Xbox consoles, Fable is currently slated to launch simultaneously on PS5. Players who pre-order the premium edition on any supported platform will gain early access starting on February 18.
